s: Jerusalem sits alone like a widow, weeping, with no one to comfort her.
God in his anger has destroyed Zion, its walls and its temple.
A man who has suffered still hopes: the Lord's mercies are new every morning.
The horrors of the siege. Zion's punishment is complete.
A prayer: remember us, Lord, and restore us to yourself.
